methodology: A listed firm needs either a current first-party page that names the United Arab Emirates as available (explicit) or a current first-party policy that describes global or country-based service availability and does not restrict residents or nationals of the United Arab Emirates (policy-supported), plus fresh structured records for every mapped product. This is explicit or policy-supported listing access, not a completed checkout from the United Arab Emirates, KYC approval, payout test, or legal opinion.

firms.sourceQuote: The lists below are the 203 countries and territories currently selectable in the checkout country dropdown on alphacapitalgroup.uk (source: live checkout configuration). Availability is always confirmed for your specific country at signup
firms.evidenceSummary: Alpha Capital's country-availability guide lists the 203 countries and territories selectable in its checkout country dropdown; United Arab Emirates is named in the Asia (42) list.
firms.decisionNote: Nine captured configurations are mapped; Alpha Three is left out because Alpha says it is not currently offered for new purchases (checked 20 October 2026). The guide says its country names match the live signup dropdown (synced 23 July 2026) and that availability is confirmed for each country at signup, so recheck at checkout. Exact purchase availability remains unsettled for One variants and Swing. Guide page dated 30 June 2026.

Confirm the platform and eligibility at signup.
